headline: Brightline Chemicals wins quality award from industry association
body: Brightline Chemicals received a supplier excellence award citing low defect rates and strong on-time delivery. The company plans to publish its audit results later this year.

headline: Brightline Chemicals reports record quarterly revenue
body: Brightline Chemicals reported revenue growth of 5% year over year, driven by repeat orders. Analysts described the results as ahead of expectations.
